title: PartyFrames Light
description: Simple party frames, optional portrait pulled from severs actions, status bars, member direction/distance arrow and sever's survival needs indicators. Expand vertically or horizontally, drag and drop where you want them, shift F8 default for setup. Only tested with Sever's actions, may not support other follower frameworks. Requires magelight.
author: nosimo
changelog:
# Adds Exclude horses under Follower selection, enabled by default.
- Applies before other follower, casual, camp and summon admission checks.
- Uses Skyrim's built-in horse-keyword classification, covering vanilla horses and modded horses carrying that keyword.
- Turning it off restores normal follower detection; owning a horse alone still does not qualify it.
- Existing settings files receive the default automatically.
- Effective settings include excludeHorses; candidate logs include horse and horse-excluded-by-setting when applicable.
